Package Server

Class EchoServer

java.lang.Object
ocsf.server.AbstractServer
Server.EchoServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class EchoServer extends ocsf.server.AbstractServer
OCSF server that dispatches incoming Message objects to the appropriate DBController methods and sends back typed response messages.

a single instance is created by ServerUI; all connections share the same DBController singleton. handled message types (incoming → outgoing):

  • LOGIN_VISITOR → LOGIN_SUCCESS / LOGIN_FAIL
  • LOGIN_USER → LOGIN_SUCCESS / LOGIN_FAIL
  • GET_PARKS → PARKS_LIST
  • BOOK_ORDER → BOOKING_CONFIRMED / BOOKING_FULL / BOOKING_ERROR
  • JOIN_WAITING_LIST → WAITING_LIST_CONFIRMED / BOOKING_ERROR
  • GET_MY_ORDERS → MY_ORDERS_LIST
  • CANCEL_ORDER → CANCEL_SUCCESS / CANCEL_FAIL
  • FIND_TODAY_BOOKING → BOOKING_FOUND / BOOKING_NOT_FOUND
  • CHECK_IN_VISITOR → ENTRY_APPROVED / ENTRY_DENIED
  • REGISTER_EXIT → EXIT_SUCCESS / EXIT_FAIL
  • GET_VISITOR_REPORT→ VISITOR_REPORT_DATA
  • GET_CANCEL_REPORT → CANCEL_REPORT_DATA
  • GET_CANCEL_DISTRIBUTION → CANCEL_DISTRIBUTION_DATA
  • GET_USAGE_REPORT → USAGE_REPORT_DATA
  • UPDATE_ORDER → UPDATE_SUCCESS / UPDATE_FAIL

  • Field Details

    • activeSessions

      private static final Set<String> activeSessions
      Tracks every session key (visitor ID or staff username) that is currently logged in across all active connections. Using a ConcurrentHashMap-backed set so reads and writes from multiple OCSF reader threads are race-free without explicit synchronisation on every check.

      The corresponding per-connection key is stored in client.setInfo("sessionKey", …) at login time so that clientDisconnected(ocsf.server.ConnectionToClient) and clientException(ocsf.server.ConnectionToClient, java.lang.Throwable) can look it up and remove it without needing to know whether the user was a visitor or staff member.

    • parkLocks

      private static final ConcurrentHashMap<Integer,Object> parkLocks
      Per-park mutex objects used to serialise concurrent BOOK_ORDER requests for the same park at the JVM level. A new sentinel Object is created lazily on first access via computeIfAbsent and is never removed, so the same reference is reused for the lifetime of the server.

      Combined with DBController.checkAndBook(logic.BookingRequest)'s SELECT … FOR UPDATE transaction this provides two independent layers of protection against double-booking the last available slot.

    • validateBookingRequest

      private String validateBookingRequest(logic.BookingRequest req)
      validates a booking request before persisting. enforces visit-type limits:
      • SOLO: exactly 1 visitor, any role.
      • FAMILY: 2-15 visitors, any role; receives 15% advance-booking discount.
      • GROUP: 2-15 visitors for regular visitors/subscribers, or 2-16 total for registered guides (guide is included in the count but enters free).
      Parameters:
      req - the booking request to validate
      Returns:
      a human-readable error string if invalid; null if all checks pass
